title: Everlasting Foods
description: Adds infinite-use everlasting food items that never get consumed when eaten.
body:
Inspired by the Everlasting Beef from the Artifacts mod, this mod adds 
infinite-use versions of your favourite Minecraft foods. Eat them as many 
times as you want — they never get consumed!

---



## Craftable Items
Surround the cooked food with 8 gold blocks in a crafting table.

Everlasting Porkchop,
Everlasting Mutton,
Everlasting Chicken,
Everlasting Salmon,
Everlasting Cod,
Everlasting Cooked Rabbit

## Loot-Only Items
These cannot be crafted — find them in chests while exploring!
Everlasting Golden Carrot, 
Everlasting Golden Apple 
Found in: Dungeons, Mineshafts, Strongholds, Desert Temples, 
Jungle Temples, Bastions, End Cities
